source: Owner supplied two chat images 3105.jpg and 3106.jpg, inspected visually; no caliper dimensions provided yet. These image files are not yet archived in GitHub.

photo_references.view: Rear/component side of gamepad with main board and pair of shoulder switch bodies near SW2, with ruler nearby
photo_references.notes: Switch pair and ribbon paths visible; ruler perspective not sufficient for dimension extraction

photo_references.view: Joystick daughterboard reverse and partial shoulder switch assembly with ribbons
photo_references.notes: Useful to identify original ribbon routes but not orthographic/scale-certified

observations: First image shows a pair of rectangular black switch housings joined/adjacent along a central taller plastic spine; exact mechanical relationship, whether separate moving components or one bracket, needs inspection.
Each switch body has an approximately circular visible button area and a narrow green PCB solder tab projecting downward into separate white ribbon leads.
Green circuit-board tabs are much smaller than the external plastic switch housings; model full switch body and actuator envelope rather than just PCB dimensions.
Ribbons route from the shoulder assemblies back to the retained main gamepad PCB; existing factory solder connections should be preserved.
The two shoulder assemblies may be mirror layouts. The photos do not establish identical dimensions or all mounting points.
Unrelated larger round/oval openings and traces in image 3106 belong to the joystick daughterboard; do not misassign those to the shoulder modules.

paired_switch_assembly_total_width.reference: Across both black switch housings including central plastic, in described button-front/ribbons-down orientation

paired_switch_assembly_total_height_in_p.reference: Top of black plastic to bottom of lowest green PCB tab, excluding hanging ribbons

maximum_front_back_depth.reference: From front of button actuators to rearmost assembly part, including protruding solder connections

mounting.holes_or_clips: unknown: investigate molded plastic retention and any fasteners
mounting.ribbon_origin: visible, exact distances and electrical pin identities held in existing harness records

measurement_orientation.proposed_view: With both round button actuators facing camera, assembly oriented like photo 3105, solder tab/ribbon tails pointing downward.
measurement_orientation.notes: Owner should confirm whether this is a left or right shoulder assembly and measure the other separately if mirror not identical.

pending: Confirm whether 37 x 29 x 15 mm dimensions apply to both left and right paired switch assemblies; currently documented for photographed assembly only.
Identify photographed pair as left or right shoulder assembly based on mainboard SW1/SW2 and user confirmation.
Measure each ribbon lead free length and its exit direction; confirm ribbon conductor count per assembly.
Determine mount/retainer method (tabs, clips, screws) and compare opposite shoulder assembly.

center_to_center_spacing_mm.reference: Between centers of the two round visible shoulder buttons, with round buttons facing observer and ribbons downward

reported_button_height_mm.notes: Owner clarified round button projects approximately 2 mm OUTWARD above surface of its black plastic housing, measured along front-to-back/Z direction. Not the button's XY center location. Already within reported 15 mm maximum total assembly depth; do not add twice.

first_actuator_center_x_from_left_edge_m.reference: Left external edge of 37 mm shoulder-switch assembly to center of left circular button; buttons toward viewer, ribbons down

center_y_from_top_edge_mm.reference: Measured down from top edge of black plastic housing to center of round shoulder actuator with buttons facing observer and ribbons pointing down. Measured at either actuator; assuming both share same height in provisional CAD, subject to verification.

protrusion_mm.reference: Round actuator face projects out from black plastic housing toward pressing finger

center_y_from_bottom_of_total_assembly_m.notes: Only applies if 29 mm assembly total height and black housing top use the same top datum; bottom is lowest PCB tab.
